name: Jotham
overview: Jotham was a male member of the tribe of Judah, uniquely identified as the son of Jahdai according to 1 Chronicles 2:47. Beyond this lineage, there are no additional personal notes recorded about him. His mention in Scripture is concise, focusing primarily on his family connection within Judah.
namesAndTitles: The name Jotham means 'Yahweh will complete,' reflecting a Hebrew theophoric name that expresses trust in God's fulfillment. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God, but it carries a meaningful declaration of divine completion or fulfillment as found in 1 Chronicles 2:47.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Jotham was the son of Jahdai, establishing a clear father-son relationship as noted in 1 Chronicles 2:47. No other familial connections or relationships are documented for Jotham beyond this paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: Jotham's biblical significance lies in his place within the genealogical record of Judah, demonstrating the ongoing lineage important to God's covenant people. Though limited information is given, his identification as Jahdai's son situates him within the broader narrative of God's faithful preservation of the tribe of Judah. His name's meaning underscores a reliance on God's faithfulness to complete His purposes, which is a central theme throughout Scripture.
